description:
The mirror-blue steel frame with sleek Mod X graphics gives this bike a high-energy look, while its durable construction is backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Ready for countless adventures, it’s as tough as it is stylish.
The full-wrap chain guard keeps moving parts covered, protecting little legs and clothes from grease and snags. Designed with bold graphics, it adds an extra layer of style and safety to every ride.
The Mod X handlebar plaque brings a sleek, race-inspired look to the ride. Its striking blue and black graphics make a statement, giving young riders an extra boost of confidence as they cruise.
The padded saddle features a bold blue and black design, adding extra flair to every ride. With an easy-to-use quick-release seat adjustment, finding the perfect fit is simple as your child grows.
The die-cut black mag wheels add a sleek, high-tech racing style while providing extra durability. These standout wheels are designed for smooth riding and effortless maintenance, perfect for young thrill-seekers.

components.description: Built for Control: Features both a front handbrake and rear coaster brake for smooth, reliable stopping power.
